description: Annual general government deficit or surplus for one European country as a % of GDP (negative = deficit). Answers "what is France's budget deficit" or "which countries break the 3% rule". Source: Eurostat dataset gov_10dd_edpt1 (excessive deficit procedure notifications, April and October). Annual only; latest year can be provisional. (cost: 1 credit)

geo.description: string, required, 2-letter Eurostat country code (DE, FR, ES, IT, NL, PL, EL = Greece) or country name; EU27_2020, EA (euro area), EA21, EA20 also accepted. EU, EFTA and EU candidate countries only (no UK)

n.description: integer, optional, most recent years, 1-100, default 5

name: eu_government_deficit
